info.title: nildiff
info.description: Folder diff tool for .NET release validation. Compares two folders and generates structured diff reports (Markdown, interactive HTML, audit log). For .NET assemblies, compares at the IL level — filtering out build-specific noise (MVID, timestamps) so functionally identical assemblies are reported as unchanged.

options.name: --open-logs
options.description:
Open the default user-local Logs folder in the file manager. Environment variables (override config.json values): FOLDERDIFF_MAXPARALLELISM= Override MaxParallelism. FOLDERDIFF_ENABLEILCACHE= Enable/disable the IL cache. FOLDERDIFF_ILCACHEDIRECTORYABSOLUTEPATH=

IL cache directory path. FOLDERDIFF_SKIPIL= Skip IL comparison. FOLDERDIFF_SHOULDGENERATEHTMLREPORT= Generate HTML report. Any FOLDERDIFF_= key overrides the matching config.json property (bool: true/false/1/0, int: integer). Exit codes: 0 Success. 2 Invalid arguments or input paths. 3 Configuration load or parse error. 4 Diff execution/report generation failure, or --doctor with no IL disassembler. 1 Unexpected internal error. Tip: Use --print-config to display the effective configuration (config.json + environment variable + supported CLI overrides) as JSON and exit. This is useful for verifying which settings are active before a run.

arguments.name: OLDFOLDER
arguments.description: Absolute path to the baseline (old) folder.

arguments.name: NEWFOLDER
arguments.description: Absolute path to the comparison (new) folder.

arguments.name: REPORTLABEL
arguments.description:
Optional label used as the subfolder name under the active reports root.
Default root is the user-local app-data Reports/ folder, or --output if specified.
When omitted, a high-resolution timestamp label is auto-generated.
